title: Instant Stir fry Noodles with Shrimps and Vegetables
description: This hearty ramen noodle stir fry is chock-full of healthy veggies, making for a very satisfying meal. This comfort food is so delicious and takes only about 15 minutes to put together. It will fast become your favorite!

source.rights: Chef Lola's Kitchen. Functional content plus a link, for internal app testing. Not redistributed.

items.raw: 3 Tsp seasoning powder (or the seasoning packets that came with the noodles)
items.name: seasoning powder (or the seasoning packets that came with the noodles)

steps.text: In a large pot of boiling water, cook the ramen noodles till the block of noodles separates inside the water. About 1 to 2 minutes.

raw.text: In a large pot of boiling water, cook the ramen noodles till the block of noodles separates inside the water. About 1 to 2 minutes.
raw.name: In a large pot of boiling water, cook the ramen noodles till the block of noodles separates inside the water. About 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.text: Remove from heat and drain the hot water. Run some cold tap water over the noodles to stop the cooking process. Set aside

raw.text: Remove from heat and drain the hot water. Run some cold tap water over the noodles to stop the cooking process. Set aside
raw.name: Remove from heat and drain the hot water. Run some cold tap water over the noodles to stop the cooking process. Set aside

steps.text: Season the shrimps with salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high and arrange the shrimp in a single layer and cook for 2 minutes. Flip and cook for another 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.

raw.text: Season the shrimps with salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high and arrange the shrimp in a single layer and cook for 2 minutes. Flip and cook for another 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
raw.name: Season the shrimps with salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high and arrange the shrimp in a single layer and cook for 2 minutes. Flip and cook for another 2 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.

steps.text: In the same pan, add about a tablespoon of oil if needed. Add the onions and saute till the onions become translucent.

raw.text: In the same pan, add about a tablespoon of oil if needed. Add the onions and saute till the onions become translucent.
raw.name: In the same pan, add about a tablespoon of oil if needed. Add the onions and saute till the onions become translucent.

steps.text: Add the mushrooms and cook for about 3 minutes. (Add a splash of water if it becomes too dry)

raw.text: Add the mushrooms and cook for about 3 minutes. (Add a splash of water if it becomes too dry)
raw.name: Add the mushrooms and cook for about 3 minutes. (Add a splash of water if it becomes too dry)

steps.text: Throw in the Bell peppers, Tomatoes and carrots. Season with seasoning powder and salt - optional (please read the note above and let). cook for about 2 to 3 minutes.

raw.text: Throw in the Bell peppers, Tomatoes and carrots. Season with seasoning powder and salt - optional (please read the note above and let). cook for about 2 to 3 minutes.
raw.name: Throw in the Bell peppers, Tomatoes and carrots. Season with seasoning powder and salt - optional (please read the note above and let). cook for about 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.text: Stir in the cooked noodles and the shrimps and cook until heated through. About 2 minutes.

raw.text: Stir in the cooked noodles and the shrimps and cook until heated through. About 2 minutes.
raw.name: Stir in the cooked noodles and the shrimps and cook until heated through. About 2 minutes.

steps.text: Remove from heat and enjoy immediately
